officialTitle: Pembrolizumab versus placebo as adjuvant therapy for completely resected stage IB-IIIA non-small-cell lung cancer (PEARLS/KEYNOTE-091): an interim analysis of a randomised, triple-blind, phase 3 trial

design.sampleSizeSourceQuote: 1177 (60%) of 1955 screened participants were randomly assigned to pembrolizumab (n=590, including n=168 with PD-L1 TPS of ≥50%) or placebo (n=587; including n=165 with PD-L1 TPS of ≥50%)
design.notes: Adjuvant chemotherapy considered for stage IB and strongly recommended for stage II–IIIA per local guidelines; second interim analysis reported.

clinicalQuestion: Does adjuvant pembrolizumab improve DFS versus placebo after complete resection of stage IB–IIIA NSCLC, irrespective of PD-L1 expression?

pico.population: Completely resected stage IB to IIIA NSCLC, any histology or PD-L1 level, good performance status, with adjuvant chemotherapy as recommended
pico.intervention: Pembrolizumab 200 mg IV every 3 weeks for up to 18 cycles
pico.outcomes: Dual primary: DFS in overall population and in PD-L1 TPS ≥50%. Secondary: safety

arms.label: Pembrolizumab
arms.dosing: 200 mg IV every 3 weeks for up to 18 cycles
arms.doseSourceQuote: pembrolizumab 200 mg or placebo, both administered intravenously every 3 weeks for up to 18 cycles

publications.title: Pembrolizumab versus placebo as adjuvant therapy for completely resected stage IB-IIIA non-small-cell lung cancer (PEARLS/KEYNOTE-091): an interim analysis of a randomised, triple-blind, phase 3 trial.
publications.label: Second interim analysis

outcomes.sourceQuote: In the overall population, median disease-free survival was 53·6 months (95% CI 39·2 to not reached) in the pembrolizumab group versus 42·0 months (31·3 to not reached) in the placebo group (HR 0·76 [95% CI 0·63-0·91], p=0·0014).

In the PD-L1 TPS of 50% or greater population, median disease-free survival was not reached in either the pembrolizumab group (95% CI 44·3 to not reached) or the placebo group (95% CI 35·8 to not reached; HR 0·82 [95% CI 0·57-1·18]; p=0·14).

safety.sourceQuote: Grade 3 or worse adverse events occurred in 198 (34%) of 580 participants who received pembrolizumab and 150 (26%) of 581 participants who received placebo.
Serious adverse events occurred in 142 (24%) participants in the pembrolizumab group and 90 (15%) in the placebo group
Treatment-related adverse events led to death in four (1%) participants treated with pembrolizumab

strengths: PD-L1-unselected population with prespecified PD-L1 high cohort
limitations: DFS benefit in the PD-L1 TPS ≥50% co-primary population not significant at this interim
Adjuvant chemotherapy not mandated for stage IB

clinicalImplications.text: Supports adjuvant pembrolizumab after resection (and adjuvant chemotherapy when recommended) for stage IB–IIIA NSCLC irrespective of PD-L1, although the counter-intuitive lack of significance in the PD-L1-high cohort warrants caution in interpretation.

tumourBoardPearl.text: Unlike IMpower010, PEARLS was positive in the PD-L1-unselected population but not (at this interim) in PD-L1 TPS ≥50% — cross-trial PD-L1 interpretation is unreliable.

curation.notes: All numbers transcribed from the PubMed abstract of PMID 36108662. Dual primary endpoints: overall-population DFS met; PD-L1 TPS ≥50% DFS not significant at the second interim analysis.
